description: List QR codes in the user's Quality QR account. Use this when the user wants to see their existing QR codes, find a specific code, or check how many codes they have. Returns ID, name, type, short URL, active status, and creation date for each code.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 50, maximum: 100.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default: 0.

type.description: Filter results to only QR codes of this type. Omit to return all types.

name: quality_qr_list
